## Summary

I implemented lane-type support and decoupled lane creation from the plan view. All changes are in source files only (nothing under `tests/`).

**`modules/world/opendrive/commons.hpp`**
- Added the `LaneType` enum: `NONE=0, DRIVING=1, BIKING=4, SIDEWALK=5, BORDER=6`.

**`modules/world/opendrive/lane.hpp`**
- Added `lane_type_` member (defaults to `LaneType::NONE` in both constructors), plus `set_lane_type()`/`get_lane_type()`.
- Declared the standalone free function `create_lane_from_lane_width(LanePosition, geometry::Line previous_line, LaneWidth, float s_inc = 0.5f)` returning `LanePtr`.

**`modules/world/opendrive/lane.cpp`**
- Defined `create_lane_from_lane_width`. It offsets the supplied `previous_line` (rather than the plan view's own reference) by the current lane's width polynomial — the mechanism that lets outer lanes be positioned relative to their inner neighbor. Logic mirrors `PlanView::create_line` (both sampling branches, sign handling).

**`modules/world/opendrive/plan_view.hpp`**
- `get_reference_line()` was already present returning `reference_line_`; no change needed.

**`modules/world/opendrive/lane_section.hpp`**
- Added `get_lane_by_position(LanePosition pos)` which scans lanes and returns the one whose `lane_position_` matches (`nullptr` if none).

**`python/world/opendrive.cpp`**
- Added a `LaneType` enum binding (with `.export_values()`, so values and `__members__` are accessible).
- Exposed `lane_type` as a read/write property on `Lane`.
- Bound `create_lane_from_lane_width` as a static method on `Lane`.
- Bound `LaneSection.get_lane_by_position`.

**`modules/runtime/commons/xodr_parser.py`**
- `parse_lane` now keeps any lane whose type (upper-cased) is in `LaneType.__members__` and skips unsupported types (previously only `driving`).
- `create_cpp_lane` builds each lane via `Lane.create_lane_from_lane_width`, offsetting from the adjacent inner lane's geometry (via `get_lane_by_position`), falling back to the plan-view reference line for the innermost/center lane; it also sets `lane_type` from `LaneType.__members__`.
- `create_cpp_lane_section` now processes lanes inner-to-outer (sorted by `abs(id)`) so each outer lane's inner neighbor already exists.
